newsitem.title: USA: Refco Group says buys broker-dealer Bersec Int'l.
newsitem.headline: Refco Group says buys broker-dealer Bersec Int'l.

text.p: Refco Group Ltd said Wednesday it bought Bersec International Corp, an international broker-dealer in fixed-income securities.
Terms of the transaction between the two privately held companies were not disclosed.
Clive Bergel, Bersec president, will become an executive at Refco and coordinate with Refco the oversight of operations related to Bersec's clients, Refco said in a news release.
Bersec's clients include institutions throughout Europe and emerging markets in Eastern Europe.
Chicago-based Refco, one of the world's largest futures and options brokers, has operations in 15 countries and is also a broker in the cash markets.

Refco recently established an institutional asset management group. It bought Forstmann-Leff Associates and hired some portfolio managers from the institutional fixed income group of Union Bank of Switzerland's Asset Management.
In May, Refco said it bought Grel SA, a French money market broker. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
